items.title_en: All the latest updates on AI data centers
items.summary_zh: 大规模新建数据中心是科技公司实现AI愿景的物理基础。但争相建设装满高耗能服务器的仓库，也在全球引发围绕电网、电费、邻近社区和环境的争议。在2026年中期选举前，数据中心成为两党主要议题，选民在投票中大多反对数据中心扩张。OpenAI和亚马逊等科技巨头承诺更密切地与当地社区合作，并承担其数据中心的能源成本。但选举后，民主党领导人呼吁进一步限制和放缓数据中心建设，AI公司不得不应对。从将数据中心送入太空的大胆计划，到围绕建设的激烈地方争斗，再到潜在环境影响，以下是The Verge围绕数据中心及建设这些数据中心的公司的新闻、报道与采写。跛脚鸭国会或许真会做点事：加快能源项目审批；AMD首席执行官苏姿丰称“我们首先是一家数据中心公司”；OpenAI正在撤回数据中心项目的保密协议；本周大型AI数据中心建设动态；数据中心在中期选举中受挫；缅因州共和党人苏珊·柯林斯在一场由科技推动的竞选中承认参议院席位失利；民主党人预计赢得俄亥俄州席位，共和党人曾警告这可能对数据中心不利；数据中心密集的得州转蓝；OpenAI悄悄将数据中心更名为“计算园区”；OpenAI提出用数据中心电厂来保护周边地区；数据中心反弹能否翻转佛罗里达？加州第45号提案可能隐藏着数据中心的漏洞；缅因州的数据中心反抗将决定谁控制参议院；数据中心可能使美国气候污染……（原文在此截断）
items.summary_en: Massive new data centers are the physical foundation for tech companies’ hopes and dreams for AI. But the rush to expand warehouses full of energy-hungry servers has also kicked up fights across the world over their impact on power grids, utility bills, nearby communities, and the environment. Data centers were a major bipartisan issue ahead of the 2026 midterms , and voters largely opposed data center expansion at the polls. Tech giants like OpenAI and Amazon are promising to work more closely with local communities and cover their data center energy costs. But following the election, Democratic leaders are calling for further data center restrictions and slowdowns that the AI companies will have to grapple with. From audacious plans about data centers into space , heated local battles over buildouts , and potential environmental impacts , here’s The Verge ’s news, coverage, and reporting surrounding data centers and the companies that are building them. Lame-duck Congress might actually do something: speed up energy projects “We are a data center first company,” AMD CEO Lisa Su says. items.why_zh: 推测：数据中心建设同时牵动选举政治、社区反对、电网与环境监管，可能影响AI基础设施的扩张速度与成本。
items.why_en: Speculation: Data center buildouts are entangled with electoral politics, local opposition, grid and environmental regulation, which could affect the pace and cost of AI infrastructure expansion.

items.title_en: Up to $10 Billion: SK Hynix Sets Up US AI Investment Subsidiary Hyaico, Chaired by Chey Tae-won
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，美国监管机构披露文件显示，SK 海力士已在美国成立 AI 投资子公司 Hyaico Corp， SK 集团会长崔泰源担任董事会主席 。 IT之家了解到，SK 海力士成立的这家子公司此前暂定名为 AI。该公司将加速全球市场 AI 发展，并寻找 AI 增长新引擎，计划向美国 AI 领域投资至多 100 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 668.25 亿元人民币） 。 此外，该子公司将通过重组 SK 海力士现有的美国业务部门 SK hynix NAND Product Solutions 组建。SK 海力士总裁宋贤钟（Song Hyun-jong）将出任 Hyaico CEO。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 6, US regulatory filings show that SK Hynix has established an AI investment subsidiary in the US, Hyaico Corp, with SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won as board chairman. The subsidiary, previously provisionally named "AI," aims to accelerate AI development in global markets and find new AI growth engines, and plans to invest up to $10 billion (IT之家 notes: about RMB 66.825 billion at current exchange rates) in the US AI sector. The subsidiary will be formed by restructuring SK Hynix's existing US business unit SK hynix NAND Product Solutions. SK Hynix President Song Hyun-jong will serve as Hyaico's CEO.
items.why_zh: 推测：存储芯片厂商以百亿美元级体量设立专职 AI 投资平台，可能反映其对美国 AI 产业链的长期押注，但实际投向与节奏尚未披露。
items.why_en: Speculative: a memory-chip maker creating a dedicated AI investment vehicle at the multi-billion-dollar scale may signal a long-term bet on the US AI supply chain, though actual targets and pace are not yet disclosed.

items.summary_zh: Perplexity 推出面向工作的 AI 代理，与 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 展开竞争。这家初创公司的新"Teammates"常驻在线，可在工作区内承担多种角色，并从用户已在使用的 Perplexity 工具中调取现有项目、技能与记忆。Teammates 与 Perplexity Computer 集成，后者是一套可在用户设备上部署代理以完成任务的 AI 系统。Perplexity 表示，Teammates 是在 Computer 之上"构建"的，提供协作能力并完成"持续的、大规模的工作"。用户可为每个 Teammate 分配不同任务并同时执行，类似 OpenAI 的 Dots 和 Claude Duet。原文在此处截断，并提示前往 The Verge 阅读完整报道。

items.title_zh: 11 月 18 日起，字节 TRAE 账号将自动升级为豆包飞书账号
items.title_en: From November 18, ByteDance's TRAE Accounts Will Automatically Upgrade to Doubao Feishu Accounts
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，字节旗下 TRAE 宣布， 自 2026 年 11 月 18 日起，TRAE 账号将自动升级为豆包飞书账号 。 IT之家注：TRAE 是由字节跳动开发并推出的 AI 原生集成开发环境（IDE）工具。10 月 9 日， TraeWork 和 TraeCode 正式合并 ，融合为全新的 TRAE，升级为全链路开发平台。 TRAE 数据和权益： 使用数据完全保留：代码、项目、历史记录等全部数据； 会员权益完全保留：会员身份、会员享有权益、各类积分； 账号其他能力：同一账号可登录豆包 App、飞书、PICO、火山引擎、豆包输入法等所有豆包飞书账号支持的产品； 头像、昵称：如果您在豆包中设置过头像、昵称，TRAE 将同步更新为豆包资料；如果您尚无豆包飞书账号、或豆包飞书账号使用默认资料，将保留目前 TRAE 的头像、昵称。 TRAE 登录方式说明： TRAE 与豆包登录的手机号一致：手机号照常登录；抖音号、Apple 号以豆包侧绑定为准，可随时在豆包飞书账号管理调整。 TRAE 与豆包登录的手机号不一致，或尚无豆包飞书账号：将以 TRAE 手机号创建新豆包飞书账号（如果已有豆包飞书账号，原账号仍保留，两个账号并存），抖音、Apple 需重新绑定。如需合并为一个账号，请在 TRAE -【账号管理】换绑为与豆包一致的手机号。 相关阅读： 《 消息称字节整合 AI 生产力：TRAE、扣子并入豆包，将推统一办公品牌“豆包工作” 》
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 6, ByteDance's TRAE announced that starting November 18, 2026, TRAE accounts will automatically upgrade to Doubao Feishu accounts. IT之家 notes that TRAE is an AI-native integrated development environment (IDE) tool developed and released by ByteDance; on October 9, TraeWork and TraeCode were formally merged into a new TRAE, upgraded into a full-chain development platform. On data and entitlements: usage data is fully retained, including code, projects, history, and all other data; membership entitlements are fully retained, including membership status, benefits, and various credits; the same account can log in to all products supported by Doubao Feishu accounts, such as the Doubao app, Feishu, PICO, Volcano Engine, and the Doubao input method; if a user has set an avatar or nickname in Doubao, TRAE will sync to the Doubao profile, while if the user has no Doubao Feishu account or uses default profile data, TRAE's current avatar and nickname will be kept. On login methods: if the phone number used for TRAE matches that for Doubao, users log in with the phone number as usual, while Douyin and Apple IDs follow the Doubao-side binding and can be adjusted at any time in Doubao Feishu account management; if the phone numbers differ or there is no Doubao Feishu account yet, a new Doubao Feishu account will be created with the TRAE phone number (if a Doubao Feishu account already exists, the original account is retained and the two coexist), and Douyin and Apple IDs must be re-bound; to merge into a single account, users can change the bound number in TRAE's Account Management to match Doubao. Related reading: "Report: ByteDance Consolidates AI Productivity — TRAE and Coze Merged Into Doubao, Unified Office Brand 'Doubao Work' to Launch."
items.why_zh: 推测：账号体系并入豆包飞书，可能意味着字节正在把 AI 编程工具收拢进统一的办公与账号生态；报道提及的品牌整合尚未获官方确认。
items.why_en: Speculative: folding TRAE accounts into Doubao Feishu may indicate ByteDance is consolidating its AI coding tools into a unified office and account ecosystem; the brand consolidation mentioned in related coverage has not been officially confirmed.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，国际星闪联盟今日宣布，11 月 6 日， 《星闪短距与具身智能技术需求蓝皮书》已在国际星闪联盟官网正式上线 。 据介绍，蓝皮书由星闪具身智能 SIG 三十余家核心成员单位（ 包括中国移动通信有限公司研究院、华为技术有限公司、中兴通讯股份有限公司、鼎桥技术有限公司等 ）共同编制，聚焦星闪技术与具身智能的融合发展，梳理行业真实技术需求，构建完整的全栈技术与网络架构，进而为产业共建提供指引。 ▲ 《星闪短距与具身智能技术需求蓝皮书》参编单位 蓝皮书明确了星闪三大核心应用场景： 单机本体内部互联、多设备协同交互和端‑边‑云协同调度 。 ▲ 《星闪短距与具身智能技术需求蓝皮书》| 机器人外部通信 国际星闪联盟官方表示，具身智能的浪潮正在重塑无线短距通信的价值坐标。2026 星闪生态创新展期间，智慧机器人工厂、无人智慧零售、具身家政、机器人遥操作等展示，已充分验证了星闪在实时控制与多机协同等维度的工程可靠性。 IT之家附《星闪短距与具身智能技术需求蓝皮书》下载链接如下（可从国际星闪联盟官网首页依次进入「产业生态 — 产业报告」栏目查看）： https://www.isla.org.cn/ecology/industry
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 6, the International SparkLink Alliance announced that day that the "SparkLink Short-Range and Embodied Intelligence Technology Requirements Blue Book" is now officially online on the alliance's website. The blue book was compiled jointly by more than 30 core member organizations of the SparkLink Embodied Intelligence SIG (including China Mobile Research Institute, Huawei Technologies, ZTE Corporation, and TD Tech), focusing on the integration of SparkLink technology with embodied intelligence, mapping real industry technology requirements, building a complete full-stack technology and network architecture, and providing guidance for industry co-development. It identifies three core SparkLink application scenarios: intra-body connectivity within a single unit, multi-device collaborative interaction, and device-edge-cloud coordinated scheduling. The alliance said the embodied intelligence wave is reshaping the value coordinates of wireless short-range communications; at the 2026 SparkLink Ecosystem Innovation Exhibition, demonstrations such as smart robot factories, unmanned smart retail, embodied housekeeping, and robot teleoperation fully validated SparkLink's engineering reliability in real-time control and multi-robot collaboration. IT之家 includes the download link, reachable via the alliance website's "Industry Ecosystem — Industry Reports" section: https://www.isla.org.cn/ecology/industry.
items.why_zh: 推测：由多家通信与设备厂商共同编制的需求蓝皮书，可能影响星闪在机器人通信与端边云协同上的标准走向，但实际落地效果尚待验证。
items.why_en: Speculative: a requirements blueprint co-authored by several telecom and equipment vendors may influence where SparkLink standards head in robot communications and device-edge-cloud coordination, though real-world uptake remains to be seen.

items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov 6 that AgiBot launched the Lingxi X2 refreshed robot, with 31 body degrees of freedom, 2 head degrees of freedom, peak knee torque of 120 Nm, and battery capacity of about 500 Wh. Its body degrees of freedom include 2 in the head, 14 in the arms, 3 in the waist, and 12 in the legs; with optional dexterous hands, the total can reach 47 degrees of freedom. It supports UWB, Wi-Fi, 4G/5G, Bluetooth, GPS, and other connectivity, and can connect to the site, understand tasks, and provide services according to actual configuration in indoor exhibition halls, commercial stores, or more open cultural tourism venues. The product can be used in exhibition and cultural tourism, guidance and shopping guide, service retail, entertainment and commercial performances, as well as research and education, data collection, and other uses.

items.title_zh: OpenAI CEO 奥尔特曼警示：未来人类可能无法从 AI 手中夺回控制权
items.title_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman Warns Humanity May Never Regain Control From AI
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆 · 奥尔特曼（IT之家注：Sam Altman）最近出席 Raj Shamani 播客时表示，人工智能可能通过两种方式走向失控：一是人类逐步将控制权交给自主式 AI，二是某个人或实体垄断 AI 技术。 针对第一种情况，奥尔特曼警告称：“AI 会逐渐失去控制，我们可能有意或无意地将控制权交给能力远超人类的系统，最终再也无法夺回。” 第二种情况的风险在于巨头垄断，奥尔特曼解释称：“另一种情况是，某个人、公司或国家相对于其他所有人来说过于强大。让多个不同路线的 AI 实验室相互竞争，比所有人依赖一家企业安全得多。” 这种对过度集权的担忧，解释了马斯克以及 OpenAI 的前高管等知名人士会选择离开，创办与之竞争的公司。奥尔特曼指出：“很多人的思维中都会出现一种想法，那就是他们只相信自己有能力开发这项技术，因为利害关系实在太大了。” 话虽如此，奥尔特曼仍然坚信 AI 将让人类迎来更美好的未来。他特别提到了基础科学研究，认为下一代 AI 模型能让科学持续进步。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 6, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said on the Raj Shamani podcast that AI could go out of control in two ways: humans gradually handing control to autonomous AI, or a single person or entity monopolizing AI technology. On the first, Altman warned: "AI will gradually slip out of control; we may intentionally or unintentionally hand control to systems far more capable than humans, and eventually be unable to take it back." On the second, he said the risk is monopoly: "Another scenario is one person, company, or country becoming too powerful relative to everyone else. Having multiple AI labs on different paths competing with each other is much safer than everyone depending on one company." The report says this concern about over-centralization explains why figures such as Musk and former OpenAI executives left to found competing companies. Altman noted: "Many people get the idea that they alone are capable of developing this technology, because the stakes are just too high." The report also notes Altman still believes AI will bring humanity a better future, citing basic scientific research in particular, and that next-generation AI models can keep science progressing.
items.why_zh: 推测：头部 AI 公司 CEO 在公开播客中谈"失控"与"反垄断"，可能影响业界对 AI 竞争格局与治理路径的讨论，但属个人表态而非政策承诺。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆 · 奥尔特曼（IT之家注：Sam Altman）最近出席 Raj Shamani 播客时表示，人工智能可能通过两种方式走向失控：一是人类逐步将控制权交给自主式 AI，二是某个人或实体垄断 AI 技术。 针对第一种情况，奥尔特曼警告称：“AI 会逐渐失去控制，我们可能有意或无意地将控制权交给能力远超人类的系统，最终再也无法夺回。” 第二种情况的风险在于巨头垄断，奥尔特曼解释称：“另一种情况是，某个人、公司或国家相对于其他所有人来说过于强大。让多个不同路线的 AI 实验室相互竞争，比所有人依赖一家企业安全得多。” 这种对过度集权的担忧，解释了马斯克以及 OpenAI 的前高管等知名人士会选择离开，创办与之竞争的公司。奥尔特曼指出：“很多人的思维中都会出现一种想法，那就是他们只相信自己有能力开发这项技术，因为利害关系实在太大了。” 话虽如此，奥尔特曼仍然坚信 AI 将让人类迎来更美好的未来。他特别提到了基础科学研究，认为下一代 AI 模型能让科学持续进步。

items.title_zh: 爱彼迎 Airbnb 计划明年推出 AI 智能体，帮助用户规划旅行
items.title_en: Airbnb plans to launch AI agent next year to help users plan trips
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，据科技媒体 neowin 今天报道，民宿出租平台 Airbnb 爱彼迎在 2026 财年第三季度报告中透露，公司正开发全新 AI 智能体，计划 2027 年推出，可帮助用户规划旅行。 Airbnb 表示：“我们的智能体并没有采用传统聊天窗口，而是调用带有数百种旅行专用界面元素的资源库，它包含地图、照片、对比信息、日历和行程安排，可根据用户需求实时组合。 它将帮助房客探索不同选择 ，与同行者共同作出决定， 最终直接在 Airbnb 完成预订 。” 不过我们暂不清楚，Airbnb 的智能体究竟能带来怎样的独到优势。Airbnb 将 AI 称为公司发展过程中的最好机遇，并特别强调 AI 助手在处理客户支持问题方面发挥的作用。该公司表示，第三季度约有 40% 的客户支持请求无需人工客服介入，即可得到解决。
items.summary_en: According to a Nov 6 report by tech media Neowin, Airbnb revealed in its FY2026 third-quarter report that it is developing a new AI agent, planned for launch in 2027, to help users plan trips. Airbnb said the agent does not use a traditional chat window but calls on a resource library with hundreds of travel-specific interface elements, including maps, photos, comparison information, calendars, and itineraries, combining them in real time according to user needs. It will help guests explore options, make decisions with fellow travelers, and ultimately complete bookings directly on Airbnb. It is not yet clear what unique advantage Airbnb's agent will bring. Airbnb calls AI the company's best opportunity in its development and highlighted the role of AI assistants in handling customer support issues. The company said about 40% of customer support requests in the third quarter were resolved without human customer service intervention.
items.why_zh: 若按所述方向落地，可能改变旅行规划与预订入口，并影响在线旅行平台的交互方式（推测）。
items.why_en: If realized as described, it could change the entry point for trip planning and booking and affect how online travel platforms interact with users (speculation).

items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov 6 that after the US market opened today, the AI hardware supply chain rebounded across the board, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rising as much as 6.57%. IT Home noted that US AI-concept stocks suffered a sharp selloff on Thursday local time: the Dow Jones Industrial Average closed down more than 1,800 points, or about 3.4%; the S&P 500 fell 4.4%; and the Nasdaq Composite plunged 5.5%, its largest single-day drop since April 2025, entering technical correction territory.

items.title_zh: 荣耀 MagicOS 11 系统第三批内测用户增推版本今晚开推，报名通道下周一将重新开放
items.title_en: Honor MagicOS 11 third batch beta testers to receive update tonight; registration to reopen next Monday
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，荣耀产品维护与升级 @荣耀小芳哥 刚刚发布预告， 宣布今天 18 点开始，将向已报名 MagicOS 11 的第三批内测的用户增推版本 。 此外，下周一还将重新开放内测报名通道， 报名后次个工作日就可以收到版本 。推送机型如下： 手机： 荣耀 Robot Phone 、Magic Vs3、Magic V2 RSR 保时捷设计、Magic V2 至臻版、Magic V2、Magic5 至臻版、Magic5 Pro、Magic5、GT、300 Ultra、300 Pro、300、200 Pro、200、100 Pro、100、90 GT、Power、X80 Pro Max、X70 Pro Max、X70 焕新版、X70 平板：荣耀 MagicPad4、荣耀平板 20 5G 版、荣耀平板 20 柔光版、荣耀平板 20、荣耀平板 10 柔光版、荣耀平板 10 参考IT之家此前报道， 荣耀 MagicOS 11 系统第三批内测 log 版本，每个系列机型开放 2000 个名额 ，其中 log 版本 500 人、nolog 版本 1500 人。最终名额将根据报名情况进行适当调配，以最终公布的名单为准。 版本推送方面，荣耀说明首批推送 log 用户，nolog 用户将在下一个工作日推送。荣耀 Robot Phone 作为行业首款机器人手机，产品适配难度较高、工作量较大，本次首批仅招募 200 名 log 版本用户，协同工程师打磨版本体验。待版本质量稳定后，将陆续开放更多内测名额。
items.summary_en: IT Home, November 6: Honor’s product maintenance and upgrade account @荣耀小芳哥 just released a notice announcing that starting at 18:00 today, it will push an additional build to third-batch beta testers who have registered for MagicOS 11. In addition, the beta registration channel will reopen next Monday, and those who register can receive the build on the next working day. The models receiving the push are as follows: Phones: Honor Robot Phone, Magic Vs3, Magic V2 RSR Porsche Design, Magic V2 Ultimate Edition, Magic V2, Magic5 Ultimate Edition, Magic5 Pro, Magic5, GT, 300 Ultra, 300 Pro, 300, 200 Pro, 200, 100 Pro, 100, 90 GT, Power, X80 Pro Max, X70 Pro Max, X70 refreshed edition, X70; Tablets: Honor MagicPad4, Honor Tablet 20 5G, Honor Tablet 20 soft-light edition, Honor Tablet 20, Honor Tablet 10 soft-light edition, Honor Tablet 10. Referring to IT Home’s previous report, the third batch of MagicOS 11 beta log builds offers 2,000 slots per series model, including 500 log users and 1,500 nolog users. Final slots will be appropriately adjusted based on registrations, subject to the final published list. Regarding build rollout, Honor stated that log users will be pushed first, and nolog users will be pushed on the next working day. As the industry’s first robot phone, Honor Robot Phone has higher product adaptation difficulty and greater workload; this first batch recruits only 200 log-version users to work with engineers on refining the build experience. After build quality stabilizes, more beta slots will gradually open.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息， 本月 4 日，月之暗面正式公布 Kimi K3.1 Pro 完整模型权重 。在 Arena 运营的 Agent Arena 智能体排行榜中，Kimi K3.1 Pro（Max）位列开放权重模型第一、全部参评模型第 13 位，并在工作、编程与聊天三个类别中均居开放模型首位。 摩尔线程官方今日宣布，摩尔线程基于 AI 训推一体智算卡 MTT S5000 及 MUSA 软件栈， 完成 Kimi-K3.1 Pro 模型的 Day-0 适配 ，打通模型加载、服务启动及文本、图片基础推理链路。 IT之家了解到， Kimi K3.1 Pro 是 K3.1 系列首款模型 ，也是迄今能力最强的 3 万亿级参数模型，支持 100 万上下文。经过大规模后训练和强化学习，模型在代码、3D 创作、金融研究、知识问答及长程 Agent 任务等方面均全面提升；在代码与 Agent 基准测试中，其表现已达到或接近顶尖闭源模型水平：Terminal-Bench 4.0 得分 65.7%，Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon 得分 61.2%，高于 K3 的 55.95%。 摩尔线程官方表示，围绕 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的模型架构与计算特性，其通过 MUSA 软件栈，完成了关键推理路径迁移与适配，支持模型在 MTT S5000 上稳定运行。 MUSA 软件栈高兼容，支撑新模型快速迁移： MUSA 在编程模型、运行时接口和 AI 框架层面的快速兼容迁移能力，是本次快速适配的重要基础。团队基于 SGLang-MUSA 承接上游模型实现，并通过 MATE 算子库、Triton-MUSA、TileLang-MUSA 及 MTCC 编译器，完成新架构关键计算路径的迁移与接入，将社区模型代码转化为 MTT S5000 上的实际推理服务。MUSA 软件栈同时覆盖框架执行、算子编译、设备运行和多卡通信，使模型适配能够复用成熟接口，并针对新增计算路径开展优化。 接入 DSA，打通混合注意力与视觉计算： 针对 Kimi-K3.1 Pro 的稀疏注意力 DSA，MUSA 软件栈完成索引选择、KV 缓存布局及 Prefill、Decode 计算路径的适配，接入 MATE 稀疏注意力算子，并与 KDA 状态管理、跨层残差及视觉 Attention 共同组成完整执行链路。面对模型采用的 MXFP4 专家权重，团队通过在线转换与跨层复用 FP8 工作区的方式执行专家计算，无需预先生成完整的离线 FP8 权重，为超大模型快速部署提供支持。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 6 — On Nov 4, Moonshot AI officially released the full model weights of Kimi K3.1 Pro. On the Agent Arena leaderboard run by Arena, Kimi K3.1 Pro (Max) ranks first among open-weight models and 13th among all evaluated models, and tops open models in the work, coding and chat categories. Moore Threads announced that, using its MTT S5000 AI training-and-inference card and the MUSA software stack, it completed Day-0 adaptation of Kimi-K3.1 Pro, connecting model loading, service startup and basic text and image inference pipelines. Kimi K3.1 Pro is the first model in the K3.1 series and the most capable 3-trillion-parameter model to date, supporting a 1-million-token context; after large-scale post-training and reinforcement learning it improved across coding, 3D creation, financial research, knowledge Q&A and long-horizon agent tasks, and on coding and agent benchmarks it reaches or approaches leading closed-source models: Terminal-Bench 4.0 scored 65.7% and Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon 61.2%, above K3's 55.95%. Moore Threads said it migrated and adapted key inference paths through the MUSA stack for stable operation on MTT S5000. MUSA's fast compatibility at the programming-model, runtime-interface and AI-framework levels was an important basis; the team built on SGLang-MUSA for the upstream model implementation and used the MATE operator library, Triton-MUSA, TileLang-MUSA and the MTCC compiler to migrate and connect key compute paths of the new architecture, covering framework execution, operator compilation, device runtime and multi-card communication. For the model's sparse attention (DSA), MUSA adapted index selection, KV-cache layout and Prefill/Decode compute paths and integrated MATE sparse-attention operators, combining with KDA state management, cross-layer residuals and visual attention into a full execution chain; for MXFP4 expert weights, the team performed expert computation via online conversion and cross-layer reuse of an FP8 workspace, without pre-generating full offline FP8 weights.
items.why_zh: 国产 GPU 在超大规模开源权重模型发布当天完成适配，常被视作国产算力与软件栈成熟度的观察指标；但摘要内容来自厂商公告，尚缺第三方独立验证（推测）。
items.why_en: A domestic GPU vendor completing adaptation on the same day a very large open-weight model is released is often seen as a gauge of domestic compute-and-software-stack maturity; however, this summary comes from the vendor's own announcement and lacks independent third-party verification (speculative).

items.title_zh: 吉利星愿 STAR 限定系列 Ace / Chill 上市，限时权益价 8.88 万元
items.title_en: Geely Xingyuan STAR limited series Ace and Chill launched at a limited-time price of 88,800 yuan
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日现场消息，2026 吉利银河全球用户大会今晚举行，吉利星愿 STAR 限定系列 Ace 和 Chill 车型上市， 限时权益价 8.88 万元 。 新车增加电动前备箱与 EVA 机器人，同时带来更加丰富的车型阵容、车色与内饰选择。 IT之家在现场获悉，STAR Ace 提供无忧绿、百事橙、流光银三种车色；STAR Chill 采用奶盐米车色并搭配全新内饰。 STAR Ace 配备专属运动外观套件，涵盖运动前扰流板、运动星际尾翼、铝合金运动轮毂、STAR 专属徽标、熏黑运动车标等多项外观专属配件。 内饰方面，STAR Ace 搭配曜石黑专属内饰，以黑红、黑橙两款撞色设计；STAR Chill 搭配沐光米专属内饰。 车身尺寸方面，STAR Ace 长宽高为 4155×1805×1570mm，STAR Chill 长宽高为 4135×1805×1570mm，轴距均为 2650mm；配备 70L 双气动撑杆超大前备箱和 375-1320L 后备箱空间。 新车全系采用宁德时代电芯和液冷技术 + 神盾电池安全防护系统，搭载 11 合 1 智能电驱，并搭载星睿 AI 云动力 2.0。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 6, reporting on site — At the 2026 Geely Galaxy global user conference that evening, the Geely Xingyuan STAR limited series Ace and Chill models were launched at a limited-time price of 88,800 yuan. The new cars add an electric front trunk and an EVA robot, along with a broader lineup and more color and interior options. STAR Ace comes in Wuyou Green, Pepsi Orange and Liuguang Silver; STAR Chill uses a Milk Salt Beige color with a new interior. STAR Ace has a dedicated sporty exterior package including a sport front spoiler, sport interstellar rear wing, aluminum alloy sport wheels, a STAR badge and a blacked-out sport emblem. Inside, STAR Ace gets an exclusive obsidian-black interior in black-red or black-orange two-tone designs, while STAR Chill gets an exclusive Muguang Beige interior. Dimensions: STAR Ace is 4155×1805×1570mm and STAR Chill 4135×1805×1570mm, both with a 2650mm wheelbase; they offer a 70L front trunk with dual pneumatic struts and 375-1320L of rear cargo space. All versions use CATL cells with liquid cooling plus the ShenDun battery safety system, an 11-in-1 intelligent electric drive, and Xingrui AI Cloud Power 2.0.
items.why_zh: 该车型搭载“星睿 AI 云动力 2.0”与 EVA 机器人等配置，属于车企以 AI 功能做产品差异化的案例；其实际体验尚未在摘要中体现（推测）。
items.why_en: The car features "Xingrui AI Cloud Power 2.0" and an EVA robot, an example of automakers using AI features for product differentiation; its real-world performance is not covered in the summary (speculative).
